notes: v546 — completes yesterday's radar fix. v544 taught the radar to see the report card's proven lines (combos included), but if the radar painted BEFORE you opened the card, it stamped every share ‘already checked today’ and the new pass couldn't run until tomorrow — which is why the label changed and the counts didn't. Now, the moment the card's grades load, the radar re-checks every share automatically. To see it: hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5), open the 📋 report card once on the exchange you're viewing, close it — the ⚖ EVIDENCE tiles refresh on their own. One honest note: the tiles use the one-week grades; on a day when no badge-holding line fires on any share, honest zeros are still the correct answer — but now they're zeros after checking your strongest evidence, not before.
